findings.detail: Consistent native text faces and weights; exact strings include all extra source axes and separate native degree glyph.
Original botanical crop matches the isolated illustration. Temperature curve is a native LinePlot bound to 316 explicitly approximate Celsius samples with mild numeric smoothing.

Source has subtle paper grain and soft tonal variation; native page and card use flat measured colors. Fixed-artboard prototype review, no claim of exact raster equality or phone/responsive validation.

runtime_regression.basis: Personally compared all seven current source/native pairs. Native numerical charts retain source trends, selected points, area shading, legends and axes; typography, cards, controls and the original botanical crop remain consistent. Approximate curve sampling, small font rasterization differences and flatter source gradients/paper grain remain accepted prototype limitations documented in the individual findings.
